notes: Scout 2026-11-27: read buriedstonefarms.com homepage, About Us, Store, Beef store page, Wholesale Beef (bulk-beef-escanaba-mi) and Contact, all through WebFetch summaries, so the quote came from a summary; Verifier: recheck exact wording.
